## 💡 What problem does this solve?

<!-- Describe the user pain point or use case. What can't you do today? -->

<!-- Describe what you'd like to happen. Include UI sketches or API contracts if helpful. -->

<!-- What other ways could this be solved? Why are they worse? -->

## 🎨 Mockups / wireframes

<!-- Attach any visual mockups, Figma links, or ASCII wireframes. -->

## 📊 Impact

- **Who benefits?** <!-- e.g. all shoppers / admins only / mobile users -->
- **How often?** <!-- daily / weekly / one-time -->
- **Severity of the current pain**: low / medium / high

- Suggested files / components to touch:
- New dependencies required? If yes, which and why?
- Migration / breaking changes?

- [ ] Criterion 3
